angle.title: The Only Suspect
angle.logline: A payroll vanishes from an unforced safe. Police build their case around the bookkeeper. A jury rejects it, and the money is still missing.
angle.centralQuestion: If the only person charged was acquitted, what does the record actually tell us about who opened the safe?
angle.whyItWorks: The tension is real and documented: an unforced safe, a single suspect, an acquittal, and an open question. No invention needed.
risks: Framing around 'the only suspect' can imply guilt. Every mention of Tallis's role must stay attributed, and the acquittal must be given full weight.

hook.description: Open on the police report's line noting no signs of force on the safe.

centralQuestion: If the only person charged was acquitted, what does the record actually tell us about who opened the safe?

sequences.title: An Unforced Safe
sequences.purpose: Establish the loss and the one detail that shapes everything: no force.

sequences.title: The Night Before
sequences.purpose: Show when the money went in and who could open the safe.

beats.description: Cash goes into the safe the afternoon before.

sequences.title: One Name
sequences.purpose: Police allege Tallis opened the safe; he denies it; he is charged.

sequences.title: Two Times for One Light
sequences.purpose: Present the conflicting accounts of the office light without resolving them.

beats.description: Testimony vs. newspaper on the time of the light.

sequences.title: Not Proof
sequences.purpose: Deliver the acquittal and correct the online myth.

beats.description: The acquittal and the judge's line.

sequences.title: Still Missing
sequences.purpose: State what is known, what is not, and end on the open question.

beats.description: Money not recovered as of April 1955.

reveals.description: The investigation sequence builds the police case; the verdict sequence reveals the jury rejected it.

pacing.notes: Fixture is short by design; real cases target 300 to 600 seconds.

endingStrategy.description: End on the question the court could not answer, having stated exactly what is and is not known.
